newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SNOOKER-IRELAND'S DOHERTY GIVEN WARM DUBLIN WELCOME.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-IRELAND'S DOHERTY GIVEN WARM DUBLIN WELCOME.

text.p: Ireland's Ken Doherty received a warm welcome when he returned to his native Dublin on Wednesday after his victory in the world snooker championship final.
"When I got off the plane I was choking to fight off the tears a bit. It has been a fantastic reception," he said after being greeted at Dublin airport by hundreds of supporters waving Irish flags.
Hundreds more well-wishers lined the 13-km route from the airport as Doherty travelled to the city centre in an open top bus. A civic reception was being held in his honour on Wednesday evening.

Doherty became the first player from the Irish Republic to win the world title when he beat world number one Stephen Hendry, who has won the title six times, 18-12 in the final in Sheffield, England, on Monday.
